notes: Weighted 1-5 axes normalised to 100. Weights encode the operating constraint: zero capital makes feasibility and defensibility worth more than speed, because a cheap idea that anyone can copy is not an asset.

axes.label: Feasibility at $0
axes.guide: 5 = genuinely free to ship (no ads, no inventory, no paid tool, free tier hosting). 1 = needs capital.

axes.label: Time to first dollar
axes.guide: 5 = plausible sale inside 30 days. 1 = 6+ months before revenue is meaningful.

axes.label: Defensibility
axes.guide: 5 = a lazy competitor cannot clone it in an afternoon (proprietary mechanism, tool, audience). 1 = one prompt does it.

axes.label: Output quality vs. average human in niche
axes.guide: 5 = a practitioner would call it good. 1 = generic listicle. If this can't reach 4, don't pick it.

axes.label: Compounding / scalability
axes.guide: 5 = asset #1 makes asset #20 materially cheaper (shared audience, list, pipeline, tooling).
